content: isomorphic-git cannot reliably handle git worktrees: when .git is a FILE (as it is in a linked worktree) it fails with 'Could not resolve reference'. It is a pure-JS reimplementation requiring a BYO fs/http layer, aimed at browsers. simple-git (3.36.0) shells out to the real git binary, so worktree semantics are exactly git's; it has no dedicated .worktree() helper but .raw(['worktree','add',...]) works and it supports worktree config scope. For a daemon that creates a git worktree per feature, use simple-git (or plain execa + git) and require git on PATH. Do NOT use isomorphic-git. nodegit (libgit2 bindings) is a native-build liability for an OSS tool users install.
